Definition: from G2932; an acquirement, i.e. estate:--possession.
BiblicalUsage: Possessions are what a person owns, and both appearances are about what people did with them. In Acts 2:45 the believers "sold their possessions and goods, and parted them to all men, as every man had need," and in Mark 10:22 the rich young ruler went away grieved, "for he had great possessions."
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the two verses are the same test with opposite answers: the believers sold their possessions and found the church, and the young ruler kept his and walked away from Christ.
